_read_me: Every image the site uses, keyed by a short name. 'src' is relative to the build pack. Swap a file here (e.g. when studio photos arrive) and run `npm run content`; no code changes needed. 'crop' is an optional [left, top, width, height] box in source pixels. 'position' is the CSS object-position used when the image is cropped to fit its frame.
